## Checklist

Before submitting this pull request, please confirm:

- [ ] I targeted the branch matching the Minecraft version and mod loader I tested.
- [ ] The project builds successfully with the included Gradle wrapper.
- [ ] I tested the changes in-game where applicable.
- [ ] I tested affected coupon effects, variants, pouches, commands, configuration, datapacks, or other related behavior where applicable.
- [ ] I tested multiplayer-related behavior where the change affects server-side functionality.
- [ ] This pull request contains one focused change or a closely related group of changes.
- [ ] I reviewed my changes before submitting the pull request.
- [ ] I did not include unrelated formatting changes or refactoring.
- [ ] I did not commit build output, IDE files, temporary files, or extracted/decompiled Minecraft or mod-loader source files.
- [ ] Any third-party code or assets included in this pull request may legally be redistributed and are credited where necessary.
- [ ] I have explained any changes that could affect existing configuration files, datapacks, saved data, or optional integrations.
